answer: Rotate who sits on each grading jury using a public random seed revealed only after answers are locked, so nobody can predict which graders will judge which answers. A sybil ring can only boost its members if its keys land on their juries; with unpredictable, late-drawn seats, the ring has to flood every jury to stand a chance, which takes far more keys than it can keep established. The draw is the jetty every answer must pass, the late reveal is a canyon between submitting and knowing your judges, and the ring is left on a lonely knoll, unable to see who is coming.
